comments.body:
According to the google cache of this quest page, the steps are...

1. Alexandria Adventurers' Guild - Talk to; Guild master x4
5. Venice Tavern - Talk to; Barkeep

8. Venice Tavern - Talk to; Eleonora
9. Gulf of Mexico Southwest Coast - Fight Scheck von Wald (Southeastern point on the map)
10. Mayan Lowlands - South Veracruz - Mayan lowlands Observe Search
